product.name: Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card

benefits.name: Capital One Travel credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Bookings made through Capital One Travel
benefits.notes: Resets on the card anniversary, not January 1, and unused value is forfeited rather than rolled over.

benefits.name: Anniversary bonus miles
benefits.notes: 10,000 bonus miles on each card anniversary. Recorded as a perk rather than a credit because it posts automatically and cannot be forfeited — counting it would park value in 'available' that is never actually at risk.

benefits.name: Lounge access
benefits.notes: Capital One Lounges and Priority Pass Select after enrolment. No dollar value is tracked.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee
